blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will see a hefty drop in gasoline prices, while diesel prices will increase by about P2 per liter starting Tuesday. In an advisory, the Department of Energy (DOE) said fuel retailers can implement a rollback of at least P4.30 per liter for gasoline. READ: Trump says does not believe China, Russia helping Iran Diesel, meanwhile, will have an upward price adjustment of as much as P2.60 per liter.
